items.title: 68515_Budd Johnson oral history interview
items.q: And, I joined his band and played with him for a while.

ctx.x: When they get back -- they must have come to Chicago before they got to New York, didn't they?
Yeah, because Blanch Calloway and all of 'em, they were battle -- having the battle of bands then, going all around the country, and Fletcher Henderson, and --
Did he -- did that -- who -- Booker, who joined Blanch Calloway?
